title: The Peter Weyland Files: Happy Birthday, David
original_title: The Peter Weyland Files: Happy Birthday, David
overview: A fully operational David 8, Weyland Corporation's latest state-of-the-art synthetic bio-mechanical humanoid and one of the androids aboard the USCSS Prometheus (2012), demonstrates a wide array of facial expressions and emotions. During an in-depth interview, the remarkable artificial person, David 8, even manages to weep. What makes David sad?  —Nick Riganas
